name: Tahoe OG
summary: Tahoe OG is a [[kind:cut|cut]] of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] from California, named for Lake Tahoe. [[breeder:The Cali Connection]] later crossed the cut with [[sfv-og|SFV OG]] for a seed release, which is why some databases list both as parents.

sources.title: Tahoe OG
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: describes it as a phenotype of OG Kush while listing OG Kush and SFV OG Kush as parents.

sources.title: Tahoe OG
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: explains the Cali Connection seed version (Tahoe cut x SFV OG) behind the two-parent listing.
